title: Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect - Annual Picnic (Women Only!)
description: Please join us for our Annual Summer Picnic (women's community only)! As we reach the midpoint of the year, we invite you to take a joyful pause with us - to reflect on the year so far, tap into the vibrant energy of summer as a moment of renewal and revisioning, deepen our connections with each other and have fun! The event will mostly be a relaxed social gathering, with some moments for more focussed reflection. It is for both our existing members and newcomers - so if you are a coach, therapist, counselor or healer based permanently in the Lisbon area, looking to connect with fellow professionals and contribute to our beautiful community, we would love to meet you! Looking forward to celebrating another year of this wonderful community with you :) **Practicalities** Please bring your picnic blanket, a refreshing drink, snacks and positive energy! We will be close to the entrance opposite the Basílica / near the Banana cafe in Jardim da Estrela and will send a photo on the day. In case of rain, we will gather for tea/lunch indoors at a venue nearby instead and will send a message with the location change. *Note: This event is open to our **women-presenting community only**, and is aimed at those who are already practicing or in training in the above professions.* *If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to one of the event Organizers.* **About Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect** Lisbon Therapists & Coaches Connect is a strong and diverse community of Lisbon area-based professionals with various coaching, psychotherapeutic and healing specialisms, established in 2022. We meet regularly to share our knowledge and experiences in order to help each other learn, grow and develop, support each other and discuss interesting topics relevant to our practices.

title: Ambition vs. Execution: A Structured Approach to AI Readiness
description: About the event: For entrerpreneurs, product managers, designers, frontend engineers, founders, and anyone interested. Anyone interested in Product or trying to get into Product Management is welcome. Most AI initiatives don't fail at implementation. They fail before anyone writes a line of code or signs a vendor contract. The tools are bought, the use cases get announced, and six months later, no one can explain what changed. This session uses a real startup case study to walk through the discovery work most organizations skip: figuring out where AI belongs in a business before the building starts. It covers AI readiness assessment, where implementations break down, and what a structured pre-build process looks like in practice. About our speaker: Marvin McKinney has spent the last several years working inside that gap, adapting enterprise AI frameworks for businesses without dedicated ML teams or eight-figure transformation budgets. Before founding [Savvy Analytics](https://savvyanalytics.io), an AI and data strategy consultancy, he spent over a decade in analytics roles at Kroger, Bank of America, and GM Financial. He now brings that same Fortune 500 rigor to small and mid-sized companies, the ones with real AI ambition and no structured way to execute on it.
